title: Member Pricing, Trade-In Uplift and Price Match Terms of the Circle Tiers
content:
| Figure | Circle Free Membership | Circle Plus Annual | Circle Total Annual | Circle Total Household Annual | Circle Business Pro | Circle Business Elite |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Member-only discount (percent) | 0 | 2 | 5 | 5 | 4 | 7 |
| Protection plan discount (percent) | 0 | 5 | 15 | 15 | 10 | 20 |
| Repair labour discount (percent) | 0 | 10 | 25 | 25 | 20 | 40 |
| Trade-in uplift (percent) | 0 | 5 | 10 | 10 | 8 | 15 |
| Most the uplift may add on one appraisal (USD) | 0.00 | 25.00 | 100.00 | 100.00 | 150.00 | 500.00 |
| Price match window (days) | 15 | 30 | 60 | 60 | 30 | 90 |

## What these figures are

The member-only discount is the standing discount on member-priced merchandise. The protection plan
discount is taken off the price of a protection plan bought by the member. The repair labour discount is
taken off chargeable repair labour. The trade-in uplift is applied to a trade-in appraisal for the
member, and the cap is the most that uplift may add on one appraisal. The price match window is the days
after purchase within which a lower advertised price is matched. All six figures are carried by the tier
of Northbeam Circle Membership the profile holds.

Where a competing price is accepted from is recorded per tier as the price match channels, and whether
the member may buy in a presale window before general release is recorded as presale access:

| Tier | Price match channels accepted | Presale access |
|---|---|---|
| Circle Free Membership | local retail stores | no |
| Circle Plus Annual | local retail stores and named online sellers | yes |
| Circle Total Annual | local retail stores, named online sellers and marketplace listings | yes |
| Circle Total Household Annual | local retail stores, named online sellers and marketplace listings | yes |
| Circle Business Pro | local retail stores and named online sellers | yes |
| Circle Business Elite | local retail stores, named online sellers, marketplace listings and contract price books | yes |

## Where the trade-in cap bites

The uplift percentage and its cap are independent figures, so the cap can bind well before the
percentage looks generous. On Circle Plus Annual, at 5 percent capped at 25.00, an appraisal of 500.00
would be uplifted by the full 25.00 and any appraisal above 500.00 is held to 25.00. On Circle Business
Elite, at 15 percent capped at 500.00, the cap binds only above an appraisal of 3333.33. Circle Free
Membership carries no uplift, no cap, no member-only discount, no plan discount, no labour discount and
no presale access, and matches prices only against local retail stores over 15 days.
